channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mikal Bridges | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mikal Bridges from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Leon Rose on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
“That bothered the heck out of me. Because it had nothing to do with Mikal (Bridges). That was the price I was willing to pay.”

Leon Rose on Mikal Bridges, Jun 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tracy McGrady on Jalen Brunson, Mikal Bridges
item.description:
“It’s not just him, I mean, we a fraternity. So if I see that one of our players is going through something, it’s up to us to lean on him and help him get out of that rut that he’s in. Regardless of if it’s KAT, or if it’s Jalen Brunson going through something, if it's Mikal Bridges, it doesn’t matter. It’s just, KAT is the focal point right now,”

Tracy McGrady on Jalen Brunson, Mikal Bridges, Apr 4, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Leon Rose on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
NYK presidentLeon Rose on Mikal Bridges as Knicks announce extension:

“Mikal is a unique talent who possesses a skillset & durability that very few players in this league have& his abilities on both sides of the court in every game made him a vital part of our team's success.”

Leon Rose on Mikal Bridges, Aug 1, 2025. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Brown on OG/Bridges:

“Those are two excellent defenders, two hard-working guys...we gotta be ready.”

Jaylen Brown on Mikal Bridges, May 3, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
James L Edwards III: Thibs on Bridges’ comments to us about minutes earlier this morning:

“We never had a conversation about it. The facts are the facts. Jalen is 20th or 21st in average minutes. KAT is below that. Your wings play more. They’re matched up against primary players.”

Tom Thibodeau on Mikal Bridges, Mar 12, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Jalen Brunson, Mikal Bridges
item.description:
“I think [former Villanova NBA players] Jalen Brunson will surpass. I think Mikal Bridges will surpass that,”

Kyle Lowry on Jalen Brunson, Mikal Bridges, Nov 4, 2024. Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Noah Clowney on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Noah Clowney on Bridges trade & #Nets pivot:

“I feel like Mikal should feel proud in the sense to get traded for 5 first round picks is superstar level…But this is opportunity to me…to see us going into more of a rebuilding standpoint, that’s an amazing opportunity to me.”

Noah Clowney on Mikal Bridges, Jul 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Noah Clowney on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Noah Clowney on the Mikal Bridges trade:

“It's an opportunity for me. No shade to him, that's my dawg, I love him, but to see us going into more of a rebuild, that's an amazing opportunity for me, and I gotta try to take advantage of that.”

Noah Clowney on Mikal Bridges, Jul 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Mikal Bridges, Tom Thibodeau
item.description:
Tyrese Haliburton on Mikal Bridges now playing for Tom Thibodeau:

“Mikal Bridges has missed like no games... We're testing the human ability here, because we're getting— Mikal Bridges don't miss any games, and Thibs almost play him 48 minutes, so who's gonna win”

Tyrese Haliburton on Mikal Bridges, Tom Thibodeau, Jun 27, 2024. Source: reddit.

item.title: Kevin Ollie on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Kevin Ollie on Mikal Bridges' struggles:

“I gotta do a better job, the team’s gotta do a better job, and he’s gotta do a better job… He can’t hang his head, either. I’m not kicking him out if he makes a mistake. He’s able to play through his mistakes and he’s gotta understand that this is a good test for him… This is an opportunity for him to grow in the midst of what looks like a dark time, but there’s actually light at the end of the tunnel because he’s able to play through mistakes and able to learn.”

Kevin Ollie on Mikal Bridges, Mar 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jaden McDaniels on Free throws, Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Jaden McDaniels on Mikal Bridges missing the free throws at the end:

“I knew he was going to miss. I just knew he was.”

Jaden McDaniels on Free throws, Mikal Bridges, Jan 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Bilal Coulibaly on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Wes Unseld Jr. on leaving Bilal Coulibaly on an island to guard Mikal Bridges in the 2nd half:

“He's seen enough... and we've seen enough in him... Thus far, he's performed remarkably. I have more than enough comfort putting him in those situations.”

Bilal Coulibaly on Mikal Bridges, Dec 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Monty Williams on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Monty Williams on Mikal Bridges' development as a lead scorer in Phoenix last season:

“You just started to see this guy that was not afraid of those moments... He’s probably a flagship for me as far as player development.”

Monty Williams on Mikal Bridges, Dec 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Ben Simmons, Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Joel Embiid on Ben Simmons:

“I’ve always been one of those people that didn’t believe [Simmons] actually needed a jumper, like he was so good, he’s just a monster….Almost as fast as you (Maxey).... I just believed that you know if he could find a way to get his free throws to 75-80% that woulda changedeverything.... You can talk about this could have happened, the mistakes that have been made during the draft of Mikal Bridges but that’s just one [of the many franchise mistakes]… but I think that’s the perfect match… I think that’s the one that got away. I just hate the fact that the way things happened….”

Joel Embiid on Ben Simmons, Mikal Bridges, Dec 10, 2023. Source: LibertyBallers.com.

item.title: Cam Johnson on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Cam Johnson on him and Mikal Bridges stepping into bigger roles in Brooklyn:

“The opportunity to go to a team and then continue to take those steps, very natural steps in our careers, it’s not like a forced step, is amazing.”

Cam Johnson on Mikal Bridges, Sep 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Lonnie Walker on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Lonnie Walker on what makes Mikal Bridges such a respected player around the NBA:

“He has a great presence. He's a great human being. A very loving, caring person. A very humble individual. On the court, he's just a killer, man. To see his growth from Villanova to Phoenix to getting his biggest role with the Nets and accepting that role and taking it to a whole another level. It just really just shows what type of person he is on and off the court, and it's well- deserved.”

Lonnie Walker on Mikal Bridges, Jul 11, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Spencer Dinwiddie on Mikal Bridges:

“If Mikal keeps playing at the level he is, he’ll be considered a star at the end of this thing, especially if we can advance or do anything special. I think we’ve got a guy that has the capability to play at that level.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Mikal Bridges, Apr 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jacque Vaughn on Mikal Bridges in Most Improved convo:

“Has Mikal been able to improve as a player? Yes. On both ends of the floor? Yes. Can he still get better? Yes. There’s some things he’s doing more than he’s previously done, which is improvement. We want to continue to see his improvement.”

Jacque Vaughn on Mikal Bridges, Apr 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Jerry West, Oscar Robertson, Bill Russell, Mikal Bridges
item.description:
“[Mikal] Bridges in Brooklyn, he gets 45 in his [third] game. That’s a new [star]. I don’t worry about, ‘Well, how are you going to populate these new teams?’There’s plenty of talent and more stars on the rise. I think basketball is in great shape. I think the game has grown so much. And I can think back. I used to hear things said about other players in the league. Well, who’s gonna replace Oscar Robertson, who’s gonna replace Jerry West? Who’s gonna replace Bill Russell, there was another wave of people, and another wave and the waves keep coming.”

Jerry Colangelo on Jerry West, Oscar Robertson, Bill Russell, Mikal Bridges, Feb 19, 2023. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
“But we are going to see each other a lot, both being in the Western Conference … so I’m sure (Bridges) is going to be trying to get his lick back next time we see them.”

Damian Lillard on Mikal Bridges, Oct 22, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Monty Williams on Marcus Smart, Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty Williams on Mikal Bridges finishing 2nd in DPOY voting:

“One, congrats to Marcus, he's an amazing defender and has been for a long time, and he's finally getting his due. At the same time, I was a bit stung when Mikal didn't get it,but I was also happy he finished 2nd.”

Monty Williams on Marcus Smart, Mikal Bridges, Apr 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Devin Booker on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Kellan Olson:Devin Booker on Mikal Bridges:

“I think you've seen it in the preseason, we've went to him a lot more and put him in actions and put him in plays. Not only can he score the ball, he can make plays for other people too.”

Devin Booker on Mikal Bridges, Oct 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @KellanOlson.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on Mikal Bridges
item.description:
Deandre Ayton on Mikal Bridges:

“He's most definitely a winner. A two-time champion. A great shooter and defender. He's very athletic. He's a THREAT.”

Deandre Ayton on Mikal Bridges, Jun 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.
